data.long_meaning: In Persian, Fariishta refers to the lady of paradise. This name is derived from the Persian word 'far-ishterd', which means 'to protect', indicating the protector and caretaker of paradise. The name Fariishta carries the meaning “Lady of Paradise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fariishta usually hope their child will grow to embody lady of paradise and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Another reference to Fariishta can be found in the Indian epic poem 'Mahabharata', where she is described as a celestial nymph, the goddess of beauty, and the mother of the Vindhya mountains.
